notes: Top bar reimagined: session tabs are now seated on the bar's bottom edge — the active tab wears the pane's own color and runs into the grid, reading as the pane's near edge instead of a floating pill. The lane chip is re-ranked to be the clear 'where am I' anchor (full-strength name, real gutter), and the project/branch separator is now a colon (project:branch) so it never blurs into a slashy branch name. Hold ⌘ to peek the ⌘1–9 workspace numbers on the compact sidebar rail, with a bigger lane-color swatch. In the AI Trail (⌘⇧L) the Changes/History tab switch no longer shows, since neither names what you're reading.
